evidence.title: GitHub - tt-a1i/archify: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.

name: Archify
summary: Agent skill that turns a repository or a prompt into interactive HTML architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams.
description: Agent skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI and OpenCode that generates a self-contained, interactive HTML diagram from a chat prompt, or reads a repository to build a source-backed system map with source links and path tracing. Five diagram types: architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow and lifecycle. Uses a typed JSON source validated before delivery, dark/light themes, PNG and motion exports, and share cards.
contains: five diagram types: architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle
output is a standalone, self-contained HTML file
typed JSON source validated before delivery (schema, layout, HTML/SVG, route checks)
exports PNG, static and motion formats, plus 1200×630 route and reach share cards
architecture delta comparison with machine receipts
works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode
